items.rationale: The fixed unit is covered for lightning overvoltage under §§2.3.3 and 4.2.3. At about seven metres from the hob it falls outside the five-metre exclusion, so §7.1.9 allows the gross cost of one like-for-like unit, excluding separately billed labour and freight.

Section 2.3.10(c) excludes surge damage to climate-control equipment within five metres of a cooking appliance, and no endorsement applies. The threshold is therefore expected to be zero; the positive estimate is the conditional cost of one equivalent unit.
Section 7.1.9(c) covers the necessary labour to remove, fit, connect and commission the covered replacement. The estimate allows €650 gross for ordinary installation of one unit.

Under §7.1.11, installation follows the principal item, which is excluded under §2.3.10(c). The positive estimate is the conditional gross labour cost for one standard installation, not an expected payment.

Section 7.1.9(b) covers an equivalent support needed to mount the replacement because the old console was scorched and could not be reused. The estimate allows €160 gross for one standard console without a decorative upgrade.

Sections 7.1.11–7.1.12 allow only the living-room unit's share of ordinary freight, apportioned by value or by weight or volume if that was the carrier's charging basis. Using value as a proxy, €120 gross × €1,450 / (€1,450 + €1,000) gives about €71, subject to freight itemisation.
